reasoning_content:
Interesting point: this lockfile doesn't contain a single external `@sw-code/` package — they're all `workspace:*`. In other words, the frontend's `pnpm install` doesn't actually need the GitHub npm registry. Let me check how the `@sw-code` scope is being resolved — the registry line is in .npmrc, but since all the packages are workspace ones, pnpm never accesses npm.pkg.github.com even once.

Let me quickly verify this by checking a few entries in the lockfile.
